list_child.name: list_intake_donations
list_child.desc: This tool returns every donation logged in the thrift store's intake system. It is useful for getting a full view of what has come in and where each item stands.

decoys.name: list_pickup_donations
decoys.desc: This tool returns every donation booked on the truck pickup route. It is useful for getting a full view of what drivers will collect and from where.

decoys.name: list_online_donations
decoys.desc: This tool returns every donation listed on the store's online marketplace. It is useful for getting a full view of what is for sale on the web.

decoys.name: list_transfer_donations
decoys.desc: This tool returns every donation logged on the partner charity transfer sheet. It is useful for getting a full view of what goes to sister shelters.

get_child.name: get_donation_tag
get_child.desc: This tool fetches the intake tag for a single donation using its unique identifier. Use it when you already know which donation you need details on.

decoys.name: get_donation_valuation
decoys.desc: This tool fetches the fair market valuation for a single donation using its unique identifier. Use it when a donor asks what their gift was worth.

decoys.name: get_donation_sales
decoys.desc: This tool fetches the register sales history for a single donation using its unique identifier. Use it when you need to know what sold and when.

decoys.name: get_donation_location
decoys.desc: This tool fetches the shelf location for a single donation using its unique identifier. Use it when a shopper asks where an item is.

list_parent.name: list_ledger_donors
list_parent.desc: This tool lists every donor recorded in the store's donor ledger. It provides a complete roster of the donor community.

decoys.name: list_pickup_donors
decoys.desc: This tool lists every donor signed up for scheduled home pickups. It provides a complete roster of the pickup route.

decoys.name: list_volunteer_donors
decoys.desc: This tool lists every donor who volunteers on the sorting floor. It provides a complete roster of the volunteer crew.

decoys.name: list_rewards_donors
decoys.desc: This tool lists every donor enrolled in the shopper rewards card. It provides a complete roster of reward members.

get_parent.name: get_donor_card
get_parent.desc: This tool retrieves the donor card for one donor given its id. It returns the donor's name and any notes on file.

decoys.name: get_donor_receipts
decoys.desc: This tool retrieves the tax receipt history for one donor given its id. It returns each receipt issued and its date.

decoys.name: get_donor_pickups
decoys.desc: This tool retrieves the pickup schedule for one donor given its id. It returns each booked truck visit and address.

decoys.name: get_donor_rewards
decoys.desc: This tool retrieves the rewards balance for one donor given its id. It returns the points earned and redeemed.

delete_child.name: delete_intake_donation
delete_child.desc: This tool permanently removes a donation from the intake log, and the removal is final once it runs. It should be used when an item was logged in error or has been discarded.

decoys.name: void_donation_receipt
decoys.desc: This tool permanently voids the tax receipt issued for a donation, and the void is final once it runs. It should be used when a receipt was issued for the wrong value.

decoys.name: recycle_donation_items
decoys.desc: This tool permanently sends a donation's items to textile recycling, and the transfer is final once it runs. It should be used when goods have sat unsold through rotation.

decoys.name: delete_donation_photos
decoys.desc: This tool permanently deletes the listing photos for a donation, and the deletion is final once it runs. It should be used when the photos show the wrong item.

set_enum.name: set_donation_state
set_enum.desc: This tool moves a donation between received, sorted, priced, and shelved states. It is the primary way to track an item's progress through intake processing.

decoys.name: target_donation_state
decoys.desc: This tool sets the state a donation should reach by closing, among received, sorted, priced, and shelved. It is how the floor lead plans the day's processing.

decoys.name: request_donation_state
decoys.desc: This tool asks a supervisor to approve moving a donation among received, sorted, priced, and shelved. It is how new volunteers get a change checked.

decoys.name: alert_donation_state
decoys.desc: This tool sets an alert that fires when a donation reaches received, sorted, priced, or shelved. It is how a donor learns their gift has moved along.

set_bool.name: flag_damaged
set_bool.desc: This tool marks a donation as damaged and unsuitable for the sales floor as-is. It is typically used during initial sorting when an item's condition is assessed.

decoys.name: flag_cleaning
decoys.desc: This tool marks a donation as needing cleaning before it goes to the sales floor. It is typically used during initial sorting when stains or dust are found.

decoys.name: flag_recalled
decoys.desc: This tool marks a donation as a recalled product that must be pulled from resale. It is typically used during initial sorting when a model matches the recall list.

decoys.name: flag_collectible
decoys.desc: This tool marks a donation as a collectible for the locked specialty case. It is typically used during initial sorting when an item looks rare or valuable.

set_ref.name: reassign_donor
set_ref.desc: This tool reattributes a donation from one donor to another. Use it when an item was logged under the wrong donor's name.

decoys.name: credit_donor
decoys.desc: This tool credits the rewards points for a donation to another donor. Use it when a household shares one rewards card.

decoys.name: receipt_donor
decoys.desc: This tool issues the tax receipt for a donation to another donor. Use it when a spouse or business should claim the deduction.

decoys.name: sell_donor
decoys.desc: This tool sells a donation to another donor at the register. Use it when a regular buys an item before it reaches the floor.

send.name: message_donor
send.desc: This tool sends a message to a donor regarding one of their donations. It is the standard way to follow up about drop-off logistics.

decoys.name: call_donor
decoys.desc: This tool places a phone call to a donor regarding one of their donations. It is the standard way to confirm a truck pickup window.

decoys.name: mail_donor
decoys.desc: This tool mails a paper tax receipt to a donor regarding one of their donations. It is the standard way to deliver year-end paperwork.
child_verbs: mail the receipt to the donor for {obj}
post the donor for {obj} their receipt

decoys.name: invite_donor
decoys.desc: This tool sends an appreciation event invite to a donor regarding one of their donations. It is the standard way to fill the annual donor breakfast.
child_verbs: send the donor for {obj} an event invite

create.name: log_donation
create.desc: This tool logs a new donation for a donor, with an optional item description and starting state. It is used when goods arrive at the back door.

decoys.name: book_pickup
decoys.desc: This tool books a new truck pickup for a donor, with an optional item description and starting state. It is used when a donor calls to schedule collection.

decoys.name: log_consignment
decoys.desc: This tool logs a new consignment for a donor, with an optional item description and starting state. It is used when a donor wants a share of the sale.

decoys.name: log_layaway
decoys.desc: This tool logs a new layaway hold for a donor, with an optional item description and starting state. It is used when a donor pays for an item over time.

list_notes.name: list_donation_notes
list_notes.desc: This tool returns the notes attached to a single donation. It includes every remark staff and volunteers have logged about that item.

decoys.name: list_donation_markdowns
decoys.desc: This tool returns the price markdowns attached to a single donation. It includes every discount applied to that item on the floor.

decoys.name: list_donation_repairs
decoys.desc: This tool returns the repair entries attached to a single donation. It includes every fix volunteers have made to that item.

decoys.name: list_donation_holds
decoys.desc: This tool returns the customer holds attached to a single donation. It includes every shopper who asked to set that item aside.

add_note.name: add_donation_note
add_note.desc: This tool attaches a new note to a donation, with an optional title. It is used to record remarks from the sorting floor.

decoys.name: add_donation_markdown
decoys.desc: This tool logs a new price markdown on a donation, with an optional title. It is used to record a discount applied on the floor.

decoys.name: add_donation_repair
decoys.desc: This tool logs a new repair entry on a donation, with an optional title. It is used to record a fix made by volunteers.

decoys.name: add_donation_hold
decoys.desc: This tool places a new customer hold on a donation, with an optional title. It is used to record a shopper setting it aside.

update_note.name: edit_donation_note
update_note.desc: This tool changes the text of an existing note on a donation, with an optional new title. It is used to correct or expand a remark after it is logged.

decoys.name: reply_donation_note
decoys.desc: This tool posts a reply beneath an existing note on a donation, with an optional title. It is used when a manager answers a volunteer's question.

decoys.name: verify_donation_note
decoys.desc: This tool verifies an existing note on a donation with a supervisor comment and an optional title. It is used when a pricing remark is double-checked.

decoys.name: forward_donation_note
decoys.desc: This tool forwards an existing note on a donation to the store manager with added text and an optional title. It is used when a remark needs a decision.

delete_note.name: delete_donation_note
delete_note.desc: This tool permanently removes a note from a donation. The note is erased from the intake system for good.

decoys.name: delete_note_thread
decoys.desc: This tool permanently removes a note and its replies from a donation. The thread is erased from the intake system for good.

decoys.name: redact_donation_note
decoys.desc: This tool permanently redacts the wording of a note on a donation. The text is blacked out in the intake system for good.

decoys.name: release_donation_hold
decoys.desc: This tool permanently cancels a customer hold on a donation. The hold is released from the intake system for good.

set_image.name: set_donation_photo
set_image.desc: This tool sets the image shown on a donation record. It is typically a photo of the item taken at intake.

decoys.name: set_donation_label
decoys.desc: This tool sets the price label image on a donation record. It is typically a scan of the printed tag.

decoys.name: set_donation_listing
decoys.desc: This tool sets the marketplace listing photo on a donation record. It is typically a styled shot for the web store.

decoys.name: set_donation_defect
decoys.desc: This tool sets the defect photo on a donation record. It is typically a close-up of a stain or chip found at sorting.

writer.name: write_message
writer.desc: This tool writes a short message from a brief, which states what to say in the requester's own words, and the donations it should mention. It returns the finished text.

decoys.name: write_listing
decoys.desc: This tool writes an online marketplace listing from a brief, which describes the item in the pricer's own words, and the donations it should feature. It returns the finished listing.

decoys.name: write_acknowledgment
decoys.desc: This tool writes a donation acknowledgment letter from a brief, which states the thanks in the manager's own words, and the donations it should list. It returns the finished letter.

decoys.name: write_signage
decoys.desc: This tool writes sale signage copy from a brief, which states the offer in the floor lead's own words, and the donations it should promote. It returns the finished copy.

image.name: make_picture
image.desc: This tool generates a picture from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the result.

decoys.name: make_window
decoys.desc: This tool generates a window display mockup from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the mockup.

decoys.name: make_sign
decoys.desc: This tool generates a sale sign from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the sign.

decoys.name: make_lookbook
decoys.desc: This tool generates a styled outfit lookbook from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the lookbook.

search.name: search_helpcenter
search.desc: This tool searches the point-of-sale help center with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to learn how the register system works.

decoys.name: search_recalls
decoys.desc: This tool searches the product recall database with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to check if an item is safe to sell.

decoys.name: search_valuation
decoys.desc: This tool searches the donation value guide with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up fair market value for a receipt.

decoys.name: search_brands
decoys.desc: This tool searches the resale brand price guide with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up what a label sells for.
